request.style: English, folk, deep male baritone solo, acoustic guitar, cello, wooden flute, hand drum, somber and reflective, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
She bore three sons to join her heart
Now at last my husband stays
Named Levi for the bond they share
The third son of Jacob's days

[Pre-Chorus]
Simeon and Levi took their swords
Against the unsuspecting city
Killing every male in the crowd
Taking Dinah from the pit

[Chorus]
Cursed be their anger so fierce
And their fury is cruel
I will divide them in Jacob
And scatter them in Israel

[Verse]
Jacob warned of the stench they bring
To the Canaanites and Perizzites
My men are few and few are friends
If they attack our households' sites
They seized the flocks and the herds
And the donkeys in the field
Took the children and the wives
And the wealth of every shield

[Chorus]
Cursed be their anger so fierce
And their fury is cruel
I will divide them in Jacob
And scatter them in Israel

[Bridge]
Sons of Levi are Gershon
Kohath and Merari
Levi lived one hundred thirty-seven
Years in the land that was dry
Amram took his sister Jochebed
Bearing Aaron and Moses
Kohath lived one hundred thirty-three
In this strange and foreign house

[Chorus]
Cursed be their anger so fierce
And their fury is cruel
I will divide them in Jacob
And scatter them in Israel

[Outro]
Scattered in Jacob
Divided in Israel
